title: Population & Public-Health Surveys
blurb: Nationally representative household, health-examination and ageing surveys — the backbone of epidemiology and health-policy research.

items.name: NHANES
items.full_name: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey
items.description: Continuous US survey combining interviews, physical examinations and laboratory tests (~5,000 people per year) on nutrition, chronic disease, biomarkers and environmental exposures.
items.provider: CDC National Center for Health Statistics
items.access_note: Direct download of public-use files (SAS XPT). Restricted variables via the NCHS Research Data Center.

items.name: BRFSS
items.description: The world's largest continuously conducted telephone health survey (>400,000 US adults per year) on risk behaviours, chronic conditions and preventive-service use.
items.provider: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
items.access_note: Direct download.

items.name: NHIS
items.description: Annual cross-sectional household survey on the health status, health-care access and insurance of the US civilian population since 1957.
items.provider: CDC National Center for Health Statistics
items.access_note: Direct download of public-use files.

items.name: MEPS
items.description: Panel survey of US families, their medical providers and employers detailing health-care use, expenditures, insurance and prescribed medicines.
items.provider: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality
items.access_note: Direct download.

items.name: YRBSS
items.description: Biennial school-based survey of US high-school students on violence, substance use, sexual behaviour, diet, physical activity and mental health.
items.provider: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
items.access_note: Direct download.

items.name: NSDUH
items.full_name: National Survey on Drug Use and Health
items.description: Annual nationally representative US survey of tobacco, alcohol and drug use, mental illness and treatment, with public-use files and an online analysis tool.
items.access_note: Direct download via the SAMHSA Data Archive.

items.name: Add Health
items.full_name: National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health
items.description: Nationally representative cohort of US adolescents (grades 7–12 in 1994–95) followed into adulthood with social, behavioural, biomarker and genetic data across five waves.
items.access_note: Public-use files free via ICPSR (login). Restricted-use files require a contract.

paper.label: Harris KM et al. Int J Epidemiol 2019;48:1415

items.name: DHS Program
items.description: Nationally representative household surveys from 90+ low- and middle-income countries (incl. Pakistan, India's NFHS, Bangladesh, Nigeria) on fertility, maternal and child health, nutrition, HIV and malaria, with GPS cluster data.
items.access_note: Free; register and submit a short project description — approval typically within 1–2 days.

paper.label: Corsi DJ et al. Int J Epidemiol 2012;41:1602

items.name: UNICEF MICS
items.description: Household surveys in 100+ countries producing internationally comparable indicators on children and women: nutrition, immunisation, WASH, education and child protection.
items.access_note: Free registration; most datasets downloadable immediately.

items.name: WHO NCD Microdata Repository (STEPS)
items.description: Microdata from WHO STEPwise surveys of non-communicable disease risk factors (tobacco, diet, blood pressure, glucose) in dozens of countries, plus GSHS school surveys.
items.access_note: Free; registration plus a brief data-access request per dataset.

items.name: HRS
items.description: Longitudinal panel of ~20,000 Americans over 50 tracking health, cognition, work, wealth and family since 1992; the template for a global family of ageing studies.
items.access_note: Free registration for public files; sensitive files by application.

paper.label: Sonnega A et al. Int J Epidemiol 2014;43:576

items.name: ELSA
items.description: Biennial panel of people aged 50+ in England since 2002 covering health, biomarkers, cognition, economics and social participation; harmonised with HRS.
items.access_note: Free registration with the UK Data Service and acceptance of the End User Licence.

paper.label: Steptoe A et al. Int J Epidemiol 2013;42:1640

items.name: SHARE
items.full_name: Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe
items.description: Cross-national panel of ~140,000 people aged 50+ in 28 European countries and Israel on health, socio-economic status and social networks.
items.access_note: Free for scientific use after registration and acceptance of conditions.

paper.label: Börsch-Supan A et al. Int J Epidemiol 2013;42:992

items.name: CHARLS
items.full_name: China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study
items.description: Nationally representative survey of Chinese residents aged 45+ (~19,000 people) with health, biomarkers, function, income and family data since 2011.
items.access_note: Free registration and data-use agreement online.

paper.label: Zhao Y et al. Int J Epidemiol 2014;43:61

items.name: CHNS
items.description: Longitudinal household survey (1989 onward) on nutrition, health, economics and the effects of social change across Chinese provinces.
items.provider: UNC Carolina Population Center / China CDC
items.access_note: Free registration to download.

paper.label: Popkin BM et al. Int J Epidemiol 2010;39:1435

items.name: KNHANES
items.full_name: Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey
items.description: South Korea's national health-examination survey (since 1998) with interviews, physical exams, labs and nutrition data, modelled on NHANES.
items.provider: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
items.access_note: Free registration and agreement to the data-use pledge.

paper.label: Kweon S et al. Int J Epidemiol 2014;43:69

items.name: Gateway to Global Aging Data
items.description: Harmonised data files and documentation for the HRS family of ageing studies (HRS, ELSA, SHARE, CHARLS, LASI, MHAS, KLoSA and more) for cross-country comparison.
items.access_note: Free registration; underlying data obtained from each study.

items.name: IPUMS Health Surveys
items.description: Harmonised, documented versions of NHIS (1963–present) and MEPS with a custom data-extract builder that makes multi-year analysis simple.
items.access_note: Free registration.

items.name: ELSI-Brazil
items.description: Nationally representative cohort of Brazilians aged 50+ (9,412 at baseline) covering health, function, care and economics; part of the HRS family.
items.access_note: Free registration and acceptance of terms.

paper.label: Lima-Costa MF et al. Am J Epidemiol 2018;187:1345

items.name: NaNDA
items.description: US neighbourhood-level measures (food, healthcare, transport, pollution, amenities) by census tract and ZIP code for social-determinants research.
items.access_note: Free ICPSR login.
